description: This file defines warning reporting categories as classes with serialization, deserialization, and string conversion methods. It includes classes for various warning types related to timing issues, RPC calls, and resource management, each with specific bounds and descriptive ToString methods.

classes.name: TooLongWaitingForLock
classes.description: Represents a warning category for long wait times to acquire a lock.

classes.name: SinkStillHasReference
classes.description: Represents a warning category for sinks holding references during destruction.

classes.name: TooLongInvokeRPC
classes.description: Represents a warning for RPC calls that take too long, including interface and method IDs.

classes.name: JobTooLongToFinish
classes.description: Warning for jobs that exceed maximum execution time.

classes.name: JobTooLongWaitingInQueue
classes.description: Warning for jobs waiting too long in the queue.

classes.name: TooLongDecrypt
classes.description: Warning for decryption operations that take too long.

classes.name: JobActiveForTooLong
classes.description: Warning for jobs that remain active beyond a threshold, indicating potential deadlocks.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the object into a byte buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes the object from a byte buffer.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts the warning object into a human-readable string.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Analyzes interface and method IDs for RPC warning.
